purpose: freeze instrument-specific AF plateau, sub-coercive test field and temperature window without using confirmatory specimens

selection.af_rule: report the minimum tested AF level where the median trace-reduction fraction is >=0.80 in each history separately; do not extrapolate between untested levels
selection.test_field_rule: rank only measured candidate fields by trace overwrite and signal/noise; final acceptance thresholds are a laboratory freeze and must be declared before choosing the field
selection.temperature_rule: report observed range; target and tolerance are frozen jointly with the lab before confirmatory acquisition

forbidden: using the pilot as PRED-MATIERE-ABLATION-001 evidence
